findings.title: Preserve unweighted events in the upsampled count
findings.body: SUM(sample_weight) ignores NULL weights. Allowlisting a project does not backfill sampling metadata on historical events or ensure that every incoming error carries a client sample rate. Those unweighted errors therefore disappear from the reported count, and a bucket containing only historical errors can become zero. Sum a weight that defaults to 1 for unweighted events, and cover mixed sampled and unsampled events in the integration tests.

findings.title: A substring match does not establish an error-only query
findings.body: Queries such as `!event.type:error` and `event.type:error OR event.type:transaction` both satisfy this check despite matching transactions. For allowlisted projects, the endpoint consequently replaces count() with an aggregation over sample_weight, which is not available for transactions. Valid Discover queries can then fail or produce incorrect counts. Determine eligibility from the parsed query and require that the complete query restricts results to error events.

findings.title: Apply weighted counting to top-N selection as well
findings.body: Only timeseries_columns is transformed; the selected_columns used to find the top events still contains the original count(), with the original count ordering. A request grouping by message with field=count(), orderby=-count, and topEvents=1 therefore selects the group with the most stored events rather than the highest upsampled count. For example, two weight-2 events win over one weight-10 event, even though their displayed counts are 4 and 10. Keep the top-N selection aggregation consistent with the transformed time-series aggregation.

findings.title: Check the dataset actually being queried
findings.body: The eligibility check receives the outer dataset instead of scoped_dataset, which is the module used to execute the query. The dashboard splitting path can start with metrics_enhanced_performance and route an error widget to discover, but the helper rejects the original metrics dataset. Thus an allowlisted widget with an explicit event.type:error query still returns raw sampled counts after being routed to the error query. Pass scoped_dataset to the eligibility check so routed queries receive the same upsampling behavior as direct queries.
